entities.name: Alphabet
entities.brief: Parent company of Google; released strong 2Q results.
entities.description: Alphabet showed significant y/y growth in revenue and cloud, outperforming both Street and BofA estimates with notable margin performance.

entities.name: Alphabet Table T1 – Actual vs Street/BofA Results Q2 2025
entities.brief: Alphabet Q2’25 results against Street/BofA targets.
entities.description: Displays Alphabet’s Q2 2025 segment-level results, key y/y changes, and compares to consensus and BofA estimates.

properties.key_insight: Alphabet’s Q2 2025 gross revenue and EPS exceeded Street and BofA forecasts mainly due to strength in search and cloud. Operating margins were impacted by one-time legal expenses.

entities.name: Alphabet Google Cloud Revenue Q2 2025
entities.brief: Google Cloud revenue saw strong y/y growth.
entities.description: Google Cloud revenue grew 32% y/y to $13,624M in Q2 2025, beating estimates and highlighting continued cloud momentum.

entities.name: Alphabet Google Search Revenue Q2 2025
entities.brief: Search and other revenues grew solidly.
entities.description: Google Search & Other revenue rose 12% y/y to $54,190M in Q2 2025, above market expectations, reflecting core product strength.

entities.name: Alphabet Consolidated Gross Revenue Q2 2025
entities.description: Alphabet’s consolidated gross revenue hit $96,428M in Q2 2025, up 14% y/y, surpassing both consensus and BofA forecasts.

entities.name: Alphabet GAAP EPS Q2 2025
entities.description: GAAP EPS for Alphabet rose to $2.31 in Q2 2025, beating the Street; driven by higher topline and other income.

entities.name: Alphabet Operating Margin Q2 2025
entities.brief: Operating margin affected by legal costs.
entities.description: Operating margin declined 70bps y/y to 38.3% in Q2 2025 due to $1.4bn one-off legal expense; underlying margin up y/y excluding legal costs.
